body:
_Migrated from issue #1116, filed 2026-07-25._

Raised by [@alva-seal](https://github.com/alva-seal) in #585, alongside a separate request for smart shelves in the sidebar.

Reordering a shelf upward also moves the separator line, so the grouping the separator is meant to indicate no longer matches what is above and below it.

Split out of #585 so the bug is tracked apart from the feature request in the same thread.
title: New UI: moving a shelf in the sidebar drags the separator line with it
